rationale: The candidate preserves the entire selected error bound and all source-admissible computations. Its genuine strengthening is the extension from IEEE binary formats to arbitrary positive binary precisions and ordered exponent bounds. Conditional absence of a trace for overflowing inputs is outside the source's scope and does not constitute vacuity.
